first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses the current completion and activation declines and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and durable early adoption. Promotional pricing may counter the competitor, but its documented 30-day retention harm conflicts with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify the most directly relevant onboarding evidence and the pricing downside before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source shows completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because its verified cohort gained short-term revenue but suffered 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle.
